topic: How can satellite link budgets be optimized for high throughput and low latency in global aeronautical coverage?
consensus_response: Satellite link budgets can be optimized by integrating dynamic routing algorithms, adaptive modulation, enhanced QoS mechanisms, beamforming techniques, and MIMO technology. This approach balances physical layer efficiencies with network-level traffic management, reducing latency and increasing throughput.
reference_context: QoS provisioning in satellite networks requires managing capacity and latency, with challenges including high fixed latencies and varying link conditions.
